judgment_calls: Pad is 32 tris vs preferred 28 (hex frustum with chamfered top); well under 210 hard max.
Frame is a 4-box crank (arms overlap grip so all parts meet); pad, chuck, bit are separate kit pieces.
Spoon bit blade is a flat pointed pentagon prism, not a screw tip, to stay distinct from gimlets/augers.
